leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a TypeScript interface from an OpenAPI schema object
Implement a function that generates TypeScript type definitions from parsed OpenAPI data
Configure a TypeScript project to compile and output generated client code
Initialize a basic code generation pipeline that reads and processes OpenAPI specifications
Manipulate JSON schema structures to extract relevant type information for client generation
Apply type safety patterns when generating API endpoint method signatures
Integrate validation logic to ensure OpenAPI document compatibility before generation
lessonTitle: Build typed OpenAPI client generator skeleton
